name: Jabir ibn Abdullah
nameAr: جابر بن عبد الله بن عمرو بن حرام الأنصاري السلمي رضي الله عنهما

nisbas.en: al-Salami (with two fathahs: Banu Salimah of the Khazraj)

orthography.spelled: al-Salami with fathah on the sin and the lam, from Banu Salimah (with kasrah on the lam) of the Khazraj; Ibn Hajar: "al-Sulami with dammah is common, with fathah only among the Ansar". Written identically to al-Sulami (Banu Sulaym), the nisba of Hushaym ibn Bashir in the same chain.
homographs: al-Sulami (Banu Sulaym), e.g. Hushaym ibn Bashir
orthography.source: Taqrib al-Tahdhib 871 ("al-Salami bi-fathatayn"); Ibn Hajar, Hady al-Sari, fasl 6; al-Nawawi, Tahdhib al-Asma' 1/142

diedNote: After 70 AH in Madinah, aged 94 (Taqrib). The reports range from 68 to 79: 68 (al-Haytham ibn Adi, Khalifah), 72 (Ibn Zabr), 73 (Ibn Sa'd), 77 (Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban), 78 (Abu Awn al-Madani and others), 79 (Abu Nu'aym, Khalifah in another report). Al-Nawawi gives 73, or 78, or 68.

deathVariants.authority: al-Haytham ibn Adi; Khalifah ibn Khayyat (one report)
Ibn Sa'd; al-Haytham ibn Adi (another report)

deathVariants.source: Shamela narrator record 1091; al-Nawawi, Tahdhib al-Asma' 1/143

deathVariants.authority: Abu Nu'aym; Khalifah ibn Khayyat (another report)
al-Fallas, who adds "aged seventy-four" against the Taqrib's ninety-four
deathVariants.source: al-Khazraji, Khulasat Tadhhib Tahdhib al-Kamal p. 59

taqrib.ar: صحابي ابن صحابي، غزا تسع عشرة غزوة، ومات بالمدينة بعد السبعين وهو ابن أربع وتسعين
taqrib.en: A Companion, son of a Companion; he fought nineteen expeditions and died in Madinah after 70, aged ninety-four.

teachers.name: Abu Bakr, Umar, Ali, Abu Ubaydah, Mu'adh, Khalid ibn al-Walid and Abu Hurayrah, among the Companions
teachers.nameAr: أبو بكر وعمر وعلي وأبو عبيدة ومعاذ وخالد بن الوليد وأبو هريرة

students.name: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib
students.source: al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil 2/492; al-Nawawi, Tahdhib al-Asma' 1/142

students.name: Amr ibn Dinar, Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, Abu al-Zubayr, al-Sha'bi, Mujahid and many of the senior Successors
students.nameAr: عمرو بن دينار ومحمد بن المنكدر وأبو الزبير والشعبي ومجاهد

companionCounts.source: al-Khazraji, Khulasat Tadhhib Tahdhib al-Kamal p. 59 (1,540 in all; agreed 58; al-Bukhari alone 26; Muslim alone 126); al-Nawawi, Tahdhib al-Asma' wa al-Lughat 1/142 gives the same figures except 60 agreed; Ibn Hajar, Hady al-Sari, fasl 10 (90 in al-Bukhari, including repetitions)

flags.label: Links al-Mizzi marks as not heard
flags.detail: Al-Mizzi notes that al-Zuhri (د), Sulayman ibn Musa (د س ق) and Yahya ibn Abi Kathir (مد) narrate from Jabir without having heard him or met him, and that Yazid ibn Nu'aym (م س) is said not to have heard him (Tahdhib al-Kamal 4/443–447). Yazid al-Faqir's hearing is not questioned.

flags.label: Lost his sight late in life
flags.detail: Al-Nawawi records that he went blind in old age and said, of al-Hudaybiyah, "had I my sight today I would show you the place of the tree" (Tahdhib al-Asma' 1/143).

bio: A Companion and the son of a Companion of the Khazraj, present with his father at the pledge of al-Aqabah, who fought nineteen expeditions and became one of the most prolific narrators of all: al-Nawawi counts 1,540 hadith, Ibn Hajar 90 in al-Bukhari. Hisham ibn Urwah saw him with a teaching circle in the Prophet's mosque, and the leading Successors of Madinah and Makkah learned from him. He lived to ninety-four and died in Madinah in the 70s AH; his nisba al-Salami is spelt like Hushaym's al-Sulami in the same chain, and Ibn Hajar's rule, fathah only for the Ansar, keeps them apart.
